prompt:
Lexkite – English learning app (IELTS · TOEIC · TOEFL · CEFR) shipped in 15 UI languages incl. German, Russian, Vietnamese, Arabic (RTL): design every label for +40% longer text, wrap instead of truncating, never shrink buttons. Use the project design system (Lexkite Kit / Tactile Gamified Prep): Plus Jakarta Sans, deep teal #0F3D3E brand, coral CTA with tactile bottom ledge, cream light background, rounded 16-24px cards. App shell: mobile bottom tab bar with exactly 5 tabs Today, Vocab, Skills, Tests, Me; desktop left sidebar with the same 5 items. No hearts or lives anywhere. No photos and no drawn people: where the teacher appears, leave an empty rounded placeholder labelled "teacher-slot" (the 2D teacher Ama or Carlos is inserted by code). Material Symbols Rounded icons. Every tap target at least 44x44 px, text contrast at least 4.5:1, icons at least 3:1. Realistic content, no lorem ipsum.

Screen (mobile 390px, light theme): the Call Ama & Carlos list, an INNER screen (back arrow 44 px + title, no bottom tabs). Title "Call Ama & Carlos". Intro "Video speaking calls: the teacher asks, you answer out loud. Questions branch on what you say, and mistakes are fixed gently." A filter row of four chips "All", "IELTS", "TOEIC", "Everyday" (All selected). A single column of call cards, each card: a round 56 px "teacher-slot" placeholder, title, small line with level chip and teacher name, and a phone icon at the end: "Coffee run for the team · A2 · Ama", "Your weekend story · A2 · Carlos", "IELTS Part 1: home, work, free time · B1 · Ama", "IELTS Part 2: a place you love · B2 · Carlos", "TOEIC: reschedule a client meeting · B1 · Ama". Footer note with a lock icon "By default Lexkite does not send your voice anywhere." and a small text button "Change how speech is recognized". Feel: a warm contact list of people who want to talk with you. Quality bar (hard): every text at least 4.5:1 contrast in this theme (no light-grey or low-opacity small text, no white text on light chips); every button, link, chip, icon button and input at least 44 px tall with clear spacing; icons only from the Material Symbols set with real names; no horizontal overflow at 390 px; in the dark theme no white or very light cards or panels. Frame (Lexkite §5d): phone 390 px; top bar is one of three fixed variants – hub screen: title left + one icon action right, with the 5 bottom tabs; inner screen: back arrow (44 px) + title, no bottom tabs; lesson/focus screen: close X (44 px) top left + slim progress bar, no tabs, one full-width primary button pinned at the bottom. 16 px side gutter, one primary button per screen.
